properties.name: Traveller Character Creation Wizard
properties.author: The Kraken
properties.description: A guided Traveller builder for Mongoose Traveller 2E on SmiteWorks' MGT2 ruleset. Characteristics - Species - Background - Careers (term by term: qualification, basic training, skills, survival, events and mishaps, commission, advancement, ageing, mustering out) - Benefits - Skills - Finish. Every roll goes to chat.

announcement.text: Traveller Character Creation Wizard 1.0-beta2: open Characters and click the starship icon to build a Traveller, one career term at a time.
